assertions: Create a known selected set including equal hashes across different tags, nonzero indices and multiple disjoint worker ranges. For all permutations of a small complete history and duplicate subsets, compare every final status and aggregate to a literal independent oracle; counts sum exactly to selected set. A stale failure arriving after newer success retains failed-attempt history without replacing success; duplicated item/attempt facts and conflicting same-attempt observations are deterministic and cannot inflate counts.

Exercise malformed/truncated/overlong input, off-by-one ranges, wrong tag/hash/index, mismatched worker or stale/invalid attempt, empty partitions, and bad transport after independently valid terminal facts. Preserve only sound facts, explicit unknowns, and bounded decoder recovery.

assertions: Failed first attempt followed by a complete retry is one successful item per selected key, with attempt IDs and the prior failure retained; assert the actual retry ranges and status. Kill or truncate the worker after some provable item records and exercise a native-zero/normal-final but absent required item report; unresolved keys remain unknown, and independent reports from a successful sibling are preserved under reordered harvest. Check no report plus nonempty assignment, a true empty workload, and setup failure before creation.

Assert synthetic negative controls cannot pass by using only a fabricated clean exit, old progress/cursor, sampled diagnostics or overlapping failure counts. Existing child cleanup and exit-status regressions remain active.
cases.location: Linux CTest cases using actual ProcessProgress supervision and worker IPC, plus any portable model cases needed.

assertions: Create 21 selected graphics items at sorted absolute indices plus one outside-range GPL library. Index 0 is deferred and its shader is distinct from the ordinary shader. With watchdog trigger disabled and core files disabled, force one SIGSEGV during ordinary item index 10 via a deterministic hook. Assert actual create calls by identity, two attempt/range records including retry [11,21), 9 proven prefix creations at indices 1..9, selected culprit index 10 explicitly skipped, 10 proven tail successes, deferred selected index 0 unknown, dependency outside the selected ledger, and nonzero aggregate. A clean paired control creates all 21 selected plus the extra library and reports complete.

Include a dependency crash or equivalent production-path assertion that a parent using a borrowed cursor cannot be attributed to a different selected hash at that cursor. Confirm actual report, not a separate toy scheduler; disable watchdog influence by explicit test settings rather than timing.
cases.location: Linux CTest integration invoking real replay scheduler, real worker/crash handler, and real controller using a synthetic FOZ and null-device creation hook only.

assertions: Include overlapping composite input archives with the same tag/hash, at least two resource tags sharing a hash, explicit ranges/exclusions, an actual extra pipeline dependency, and nonzero repeated loops. Report exactly one outcome per selected logical item and no count from repeat iterations or dependency-only work. A dependency-only execution in another worker or attempt cannot replace its selected result.

Assert actual pipeline read/parse, unsupported, dependency-blocked, validation, create failure, success and validated creation-hint skip statuses, where case fixtures may be split. Check a first-success/later-failure loop remains unsuccessful and zero iterations have no creation success. Assert recovered-prefix and unavailable-required input cannot claim unseen coverage; include known empty and nonempty incomplete controls. Test real ordinary and quiet worker production output separately from capped diagnostics.

assertions: Generate a large deterministic workload (at least 100,000 selected items) across tags/ranges with repeated observations, out-of-order facts, known losses and more attempts or samples than detailed history retention. Measure accounted backing storage/capacity against the documented numeric formula and require exact independent expected final distribution. Repeat with diagnostic emission capped/disabled and confirm the same authoritative distribution; the cap or a full ring cannot alter outcomes. Assert observed history omissions and that invalid frame sizes and duplicate bursts do not increase retained state.

Use a disposable exact-candidate clone/worktree/build and retain the single-line mutation, test IDs, expected nonzero status and diagnostic; a build failure or fixture crash alone is not evidence.

prerequisites: Fresh accepted work-unit and final checks against exact candidate, managed issue readiness and unchanged material inputs.

implementation: Build an internal indexed run reconciliation model against ReplaySelectionReport stable_hashes and effective per-tag offsets. Keep the authoritative item identity mapped to the initial logical set and disjoint worker assignments across retries. Validate worker/attempt, tag, absolute range index and hash against controller-assigned work before applying facts; check arithmetic, empty ranges, invalid records and wrong/stale sources. Derive contiguous confirmation, when retained for diagnostics, from actual terminal facts only. Keep controller resume cursors separate and preserve current scheduling/retry policy.

Attach terminal facts to actual production paths. Translate parser work's chunk-local index to the stable selected index or resolve through the stable selection identity. Distinguish selected work from extra parents with borrowed indices, including when an out-of-assignment parent hash is selected by a different worker. Cover read and parse rejection/missing acknowledgement, selected dependency-blocked work both at enqueue and deferred scheduling, blacklist/unsupported, validation and Vulkan failure, and successful completion only after all requested iterations succeed with no validation error. Cache hint membership gets its own result only at the actual selected skip under the active v1 device-mode and pipelineCacheUUID policy. A setup/early return must leave unprocessed selected work unknown and must not masquerade as empty; selection can be established before Vulkan initialization and hint application recorded later. Preserve zero-iteration invocation behavior while never reporting creation success for zero iterations.

Use bounded unsampled item evidence on ordinary worker paths, with the same shared codec/model consumed by both platform controllers, or an equally reliable private channel. Explicitly distinguish terminal item data from sampled FZ18 detail, COUNTS, FINAL, legacy validation/crash records, and activity counters. Deliver surviving individual records when practical before later hard death, with bounded framing/no allocation from untrusted record length. Missing, malformed, conflicting, wrong-worker, out-of-assignment or truncated evidence cannot manufacture coverage; a successful native exit/FINAL/drained flag alone proves no item's outcome. Keep evidence transport outside crash signal locks; mark a skipped culprit only when the legacy marker matches that attempt's stable selected index and hash, and preserve dependency crashes as unresolved attribution.

Reconcile using a deterministic attempt and status policy. Equivalent duplicate and reordered observations yield the same final item state. A newer authoritative completion supersedes a stale failure, with evidence of the earlier failure retained. Preserve explicit results independently of missing results for other items and retain unreported entries as unknown. Bound in-memory storage by selected items plus worker slots with compact fixed-width states and an explicit bounded prior-attempt representation; keep attempt identifiers, failed-attempt totals and relevant earlier item failure evidence, and explicitly report history omissions if detailed retention is capped. Do not hold a raw event vector per item/attempt. Document the concrete bound including capacity and dedup state, and keep correctness independent of warning/diagnostic sampling.

Report once from a normal invocation or controller termination after collecting all available worker evidence, including cleanup paths, with unknown evidence and discovery kept explicit. An old/optional diagnostic producer cannot be silently treated as a source of authoritative item completion. Keep native success/failure and prior error gates in place, including failed setup, controlled failure and skipped culprit, and prevent an ordinary successful required worker assignment from certifying missing logical reports. Keep existing quiet behavior and preserve independently meaningful native and timeout evidence. Update tests using synthetic worker transport to send real terminal facts for any claimed known completion.

Document contract, per-item outcome and replay identity rules, private transport boundaries, retained history, memory formula and verification scope in the existing replay worker and verification documentation. Add a one-sentence [Observability] CHANGELOG entry linked to issue #21. Keep changed scope and evidence limitations accurate.
non_goals: Do not redesign scheduler ordering, dependency replay, quarantine or progress weighting. Reporting the reordered deferred item as unfinished is sufficient; this issue does not require forcing unrelated work to finish after a fatal failure.

No new public structured-result schema, SharedControlBlock change, driver-cache or persistence guarantee, Steam presentation/scheduling integration, or native Windows execution. The user expressly waived Windows execution. Keep paired Windows source behavior as feasible and identify it as unverified. CPU/null-device tests do not verify actual Vulkan/driver-cache hardware behavior.

original.requirement:
Legacy identity: `FOS-000012`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

12. **FOS-000012 — Reconcile final logical items across recovery attempts.** **M, split types/range-recovery if necessary; depends on `FOS-000009`, `FOS-000010`, `FOS-000011`; §2–§4.** Current atomics count activity and broad skips, while [condensed progress:71](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/fossilize_external_replayer.cpp#L71) explicitly clamps/weights counts and documents retry duplication. Preserve that UI estimate, but add authoritative accounting by selected `(tag, hash)` and attempt within a run/input scope. Distinguish selected work from extra dependencies and benchmark repetitions. Each selected item gets one final outcome; attempts retain their history. **Check:** duplicate/reordered messages, stale attempt failure after successful retry, one crash plus skipped culprit plus successful tail, unreported worker work. Do not infer exact successful counts by subtracting overlapping failure counters. Bound memory using range summaries/compact tables where possible; lost evidence must remain unknown.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Reconciliation model/property tests:** For a known selected set, every item has exactly one final outcome and final counts sum to that set. Permutations and duplicates of equivalent event histories yield the same final result; a stale failure cannot overwrite a newer authoritative success.
   - **Recovery and evidence-loss tests:** Failed attempt then complete retry succeeds with attempt history retained; skipped culprit plus successful tail remains incomplete. Lost reports retain unknown scope/counts. Extra dependencies, duplicate hashes across inputs and benchmark repetitions obey the declared identity rules without inflating selected-item counts.
   - **Bounded-state stress test:** Reconciliation of a generated large workload respects a documented state-size bound for the chosen representation; log sampling cannot alter authoritative accounting.

<!-- fossilize-migration-v1:FOS-000012 -->

scope: Single work unit for the root issue. Account for each selected graphics, compute and ray-tracing pipeline exactly once within one replay invocation and its selected composite input and discovery policy. Existing replay selection chooses the stable tag/hash set before replay-v1 hints. Duplicate source archives providing the same tag/hash collapse under the existing resolver policy; equal hashes of different tags are distinct. Static/shader inputs and extra dependency execution remain operational work outside selected pipeline accounting. Keep the existing estimated/weighted progress behavior and SharedControlBlock layout and public callers.

Production scope is standalone and robust master/slave, including the master used by --progress. Ordinary completion and controlled failure expose a compact reconciliation summary through the existing CLI logging path and a private inspectable result by item. The controller accounts for all original assignments, including workers that did not report or launch and cancelled siblings. Keep private transport independent of quiet, warning sample caps and the optional shared progress ring.

Authoritative final classes distinguish completed creation, a compatible replay-v1 hint, unsupported, dependency-blocked, other failed, crash culprit skipped by recovery, and unfinished/unknown; separate no-execution policy such as zero benchmark iterations from success if needed. Discovered selected totals and coverage of the requested scope are separate facts. For a known selected set the mutually exclusive final counts always sum to it; on incomplete discovery report the known subset with the missing extent explicitly unknown. Name accepted recovered-prefix or optional-input scope without implying complete underlying input discovery.

Known terminal evidence is useful even on an abnormal attempt. A resume index schedules a retry and may skip a selected culprit, but establishes no contiguous prefix, successful tail, or other work. A retained complete retry can supersede earlier evidence without erasing the earlier attempt. Supporting production ordering evidence: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/21#issuecomment-6561225073.
